Welcome!

我的老师...
是阿鲁贝鲁塔（ARUBERUTA）的甜点工匠。

scripts.text:
[Sugar]

heartfelt like

scripts.text:

Since there is a limitation in numbers
Not more than ^ff0000 5 pieces^000000.

scripts.text:
[Sugar]
It is a candy, and the price is
3000 Zeny each.
How many do you like to purchase?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Sugar]

scripts.translation:

[Sugar]

scripts.text:
[Sugar]
Thank you!!!
These sweets are really delicious.
Since my teacher of sweet is the No.1 teacher's in world!
Although you may eat by yourself

Please take care!!!
scripts.translation:
[舒格尔]
谢谢！！！
这些甜点真的很好吃。
因为我的甜点老师是全世界第一的老师！
虽然您可以自己吃，
但别吃太多，不然会变胖的。
请保重！！！

scripts.text:
[Sugar]
Yes
The teacher of mine
is Mr. Kuberu, a sweets craftsman.
Making sweets under two persons.
which is allowed to self-train.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Sugar]
Although selling is seemingly to carried out ....

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Sugar]
???

^ff0000 5 pieces^000000 at once.
scripts.translation:

^ff0000 5 个^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sugar]
???

to make that purchase.

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Sugar]
Really .... You might regret it..
If you change your mind.
I am just here ok.
Have a nice day!
scripts.translation:
[舒格尔]

如果您改变主意了，
我就在这里哦。
祝您有美好的一天！
